rows.phase_implication: Controls phase scope, no-replay rule, cross-platform exclusion, document caps, commit cap, and exact Ilyra route.
Use the Git filtered blob domain when content identity matters.
Batch object reads avoid per-object process overhead and preserve committed-byte truth.
Compatibility and deprecation decisions need explicit public contract boundaries.
Release provenance, protected integrity, and retained artifacts support bounded configuration-management controls.
Causal perturbation extends time-ordered distributions and leaves renormalization obligations; it is not empirical GMUT confirmation.
Superevents unify candidates and inherit preferred-event significance, localization and classification.
Official alert fields define a format contract, not a GMUT likelihood or physical result.
Client attestation and proof of possession are key-bound; trust resolution and parts of attester interaction remain out of scope.
Deterministic encoding, unique map keys and application-level validity need explicit handling.
COSE algorithm and duplicate-label processing need fail-closed policy.
Change meaning must not rely on colour alone and structural checks cannot replace user evaluation.
ins and del represent additions and deletions with structural constraints.
Fisher-information bounds concern physical or stochastic dynamics and do not measure psyche, urgency or agency.
A 2026 accepted result is useful watch material but remains domain-specific and non-convertible to personhood claims.
Longitudinal causal estimation with treatment-confounder feedback requires explicit identifying assumptions, weighting, diagnostics and positivity; a software fixture is not participant evidence.
Serious-harm assessment, notification and affected-person duties require competent real-world decisions; repository software cannot make them.
Maori data should remain under Maori governance; software artifacts confer no Maori authority.
The CLI may be updated after a stable-channel check; the desktop package remains status-only in this phase.
